scope: New natural custom-start tactical prefixes. Native rules only; no AI ranking, win-rate, universal forced-chain or latency claim.
prefixFormat: Each pair is a BLACK action followed by a WHITE action; null means a real skipTurn. After WHITE, every extra seat skips in actual turn order. Never assign currentPlayer or board state.

replyDomain.defenseAndCountercut: Every legal direct cut on BLACK line points, plus PASS, for every intervening actual actor until BLACK next moves. Branches recompute legality and retain full Superko history.
replyDomain.chainFirstRound: Every WHITE legal placement plus PASS; every later intervening actor's legal direct cut on BLACK lines plus PASS, until BLACK next moves.
replyDomain.chainSecondRound: After a damaging second cut on WHITE, every intervening actor's legal direct cut on BLACK lines plus PASS.
replyDomain.limitation: Extra players' arbitrary non-cut placements are outside this finite reply domain. This is not an unrestricted multiplayer forced-win proof. C has a safe immediate two-node capture, so never assert its two-step attack is uniquely best.

fixtures.reason: The prefix already contains the first WHITE supply cut. Both alternatives capture one WHITE node; only the repair cuts the first cutter off and restores BLACK supply before the next cut.
The thin attacking branch captures one WHITE node but exposes two BLACK nodes to a legal supply cut. This is an exposure witness, not proof that every capture-sacrifice is bad.

The supply point and independent loop preserve nodes under countercuts. Every admitted reply branch must leave a damaging second cut with a safe direct-cut reply round. The immediate two-node alternative forbids a unique-best-action assertion for the chain move.
